ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Child Process Of BgInfo.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious child processes of "BgInfo.exe" which could be a sign of potential abuse of the binary to proxy execution via external VBScript

sequences.query: ((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\bginfo\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\bginfo64\\\.exe$")) AND ((process_path = RGX("\\\\calc\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\notepad\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$")) OR (process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Roaming\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\PerfLogs\\\\.*"))))
